_about: Muni buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py), trolleybuses included. Muni Metro, the F and E streetcars and the cable cars are drawn by the muni layer, so only buses are kept ('types'). SFMTA's 'current' file sometimes lags its schedule changes (in October 2026 it still ended August 28), so every address is tried and the one that runs latest wins ('preferCurrent'); a feed that has run out is counted on its last full week. Express routes are numbered with an X (1X, 8AX, 30X...); Rapid routes, lettered R (5R, 9R, 14R...), are left to the frequency families; the owl network is numbered 90 to 97 plus the L Owl and N Owl buses. Bus substitutes for Muni Metro lines (FBUS, KBUS, NBUS, TBUS) and the 714 BART Early Bird are left out ('skip'). Names come in capitals; 'routeNames' and 'stopNames' tidy them. Muni Metro's J, K, L, M, N and T, the F and E streetcars and the cable cars (PM, PH and California, listed under both C and CA since feeds differ) are kept apart as rapid lines ('rapid', in raw/surface/rapid_*.json, each shape with its stops in order) for the Routes page only; the map still draws them from the muni layer. 'sched' writes the timetable the Routes page shows when nothing is live. 'feeds' also adds the buses of the agencies that bring riders into the city (October 31, 2026): AC Transit's Transbay lines (lettered, into the Salesforce Transit Center), Golden Gate Transit from Marin and Sonoma, and SamTrans from San Mateo County, from OpenStreetMap (engine/osm_routes.py) like Chicago's Pace, so no key is needed: routes and stops, no timetables. All three share the mode 'regional' and carry their agency's short name before the number.

bart._about: BART (for the Routes page only; the map draws BART from its own layer): every line is rapid, each published as two routes (Yellow-N, Yellow-S) that 'merge' joins into one route with two directions, under ids of their own (BART-Yellow) so they can't clash with Muni's route numbers. BART's live trip updates name trips, not routes, so 'tripRoutes' writes trip_routes.json for the arrivals function. The bus bridges (BridgeA, BridgeB) are left out.
